rebind_source.bind_checkpoint:
def bind_checkpoint(self, checkpoint) -> None:
    """Rebind learned material without recompiling the semantic RuleSet.

        A changed checkpoint gets a new evaluator binding and a fresh TT, so
        entries can never be reused under a different value function.
        """
    checkpoint.validate_ruleset(self._compiled)
    if checkpoint.checkpoint_id == self._checkpoint_id:
        return
    self._set_checkpoint_values(checkpoint)
    self._capsule = self._new_capsule()
rebind_source.bind_evaluator:
def bind_evaluator(self, board_values, hand_values, dynamic_values=None, spatial_occupancy_values=None, localized_control_values=None, compact_values=None, *, evaluator_scale: int=1) -> None:
    board = _profile_tuple(self._native_rules, board_values)
    hand = _profile_tuple(self._native_rules, hand_values)
    if (board is None) != (hand is None):
        raise ValueError('board_values and hand_values must be supplied together')
    self._board_values, self._hand_values = (board, hand)
    self._dynamic_values = _dynamic_tuple(dynamic_values)
    self._spatial_values = _spatial_tuple(self._native_rules, spatial_occupancy_values)
    self._localized_control_values = _localized_control_tuple(localized_control_values)
    self._compact_values = None if compact_values is None else dict(compact_values)
    if isinstance(evaluator_scale, bool) or not isinstance(evaluator_scale, int) or (not 1 <= evaluator_scale <= 1024):
        raise ValueError('evaluator_scale must be an integer in [1, 1024]')
    self._evaluator_scale = evaluator_scale
    self._checkpoint_id = None
    self._capsule = self._new_capsule()

decisions: Persistent leaf values are not captured by result fields; direct binding can have checkpoint_id=None. Record exact constructor/bind arguments plus native_evaluator_values before each call.
Ordering profile and leaf profile are distinct capsule arguments; ordering_checkpoint_id is not complete leaf identity.
bind_evaluator rebuilds capsule and clears checkpoint ID; bind_checkpoint equal ID short-circuits. Record capsule lifecycle and inherited TT, not only max_depth.
Getter normalizes absent scalar arrays to empty tuples and returns compact dict reference; take an immutable deep snapshot for evidence. Getter is not a historical capsule attestation.
Policy payload has its own model hash and deferred flag; common material-only comparison disables policy/ordering profiles and records cache settings.
scope: Source audit of fixed persistent wrapper, not C execution or correctness certification of every supported learned configuration.
